player_0.content: New plan: I got stuck in a loop between Gallery and Bathroom, repeatedly going north and then south. What is worse, after going back and forth for some time, I decided to continue visiting the same rooms instead of exploring other rooms. Next time, I will pay more attention to the available directions in each room and try to visit rooms that I haven't been to before. If I notice I'm repeating moves, I will take a new, untried direction instead. I will also try to avoid revisiting rooms that I've already been to, unless I have a good reason to believe that there's a new path or a new room that I haven't seen yet.
